s1.syndrome_frame: Acute loss of consciousness with transient unresponsiveness during a specific activity, associated with cardiovascular abnormalities
salient_findings: Unresponsiveness during descent on a commercial flight
Left ventricular hypertrophy with intra-atrial conduction delay and ST-segment elevations/depressions
Moderate concentric left ventricular hypertrophy with left ventricular outflow tract obstruction
key_facts: Normal heart rate and blood pressure
Jugular venous pressure less than 5 cm H2O
ECG findings include normal sinus rhythm, left ventricular hypertrophy, and ST-segment elevations/depressions
Echocardiogram findings include moderate concentric left ventricular hypertrophy and left ventricular outflow tract obstruction

shortlist.label: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's echocardiogram shows moderate concentric left ventricular hypertrophy and left ventricular outflow tract obstruction, consistent with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy

shortlist.label: Hypertensive heart disease
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of hypertension, which is a risk factor for hypertensive heart disease, and the echocardiogram shows left ventricular hypertrophy

shortlist.label: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's ECG shows intra-atrial conduction delay and T-wave inversions, which can be seen in arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy

shortlist.label: Obstructive sleep apnea
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's recent increased alcohol use and obesity (implied by hypertension) increase the risk for obstructive sleep apnea, which can cause cardiac abnormalities

shortlist.label: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's recent increased alcohol use and stress from the flight could trigger takotsubo cardiomyopathy, which can cause transient left ventricular dysfunction
